classificationMethod.description: Current main workflow arrivals remain automatic main arrivals even when a commit message mentions a trial; repository agent events and manual runs remain separate

limitations: Run arrival counts do not imply jobs executed; event filters and job conditions can skip jobs
Workflow names and branch markers do not prove complete experiment-intent classification
Historical workflow paths may differ from the current 17-file inventory
API lists latest run state and run_attempt, not separate records for every retry
No account-wide usage, billed minutes, workflow elapsed-time ROI, or expanded-task cost forecast is inferred
